scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p shared && tsc -p functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cherrytree "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase use dev && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:functions:dev: firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only hosting
